title: Hull Area Graded
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n. Then n lines: x y. Print the doubled area
of the convex hull.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; 0 ≤ x, y ≤ 10^9.

The W applies the shoelace to the INPUT order — wrong for unsorted
polygons.

tests.name: triangle
L-shape with notch and interior point
tests.hint: Both (2,2) and (1,1) fall INSIDE the hull of the six extreme points; hull area2 = 28.

tests.name: load: 200000 random points
tests.hint: The shoelace-over-input-order W walks the points in given order — garbage on unsorted input.
